stuckbit.in: bit = k % 64, value = k / 64: 128 of 128 instances (64 bits x 2 values)
stuckbit.acc: bit = k % 64, value = k / 64: 128 of 128 instances (64 bits x 2 values)
stuckbit.out: bit = k % 64, value = k / 64: 128 of 128 instances (64 bits x 2 values)
stuckbit.block: bit = (k * 257) % 32768, value = k / 64: 128 of 65,536 instances (32,768 bits x 2 values)

definitions.detected: caught == 1: the voter reacted to the faulty replica
definitions.wrong_before_detection: wrong results in a detected run (no upsets; a persistent fault halts the run at detection, as the last replica is retired)
definitions.wrong_rate_when_missed: wrong results / results delivered from the fault tick on, over the missed runs
definitions.latency: ticks from the fault to detection, over the detected runs
definitions.kat_tests_per_delivered_result: known-answer tests / correct and wrong results delivered, over the runs (exact)
definitions.cpu_s_q1_q3_iqr: first and third quartiles of CPU time over the runs (linear interpolation), and their difference
definitions.cpu_cost_vs_no_test: median CPU time (voter and replicas) / the median at period 1000000, minus 1
definitions.model_extra_computes: 1 / P: one KAT computation per P ticks, against P computations for P / 2 self-checked results
